transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... I'm just having a lot of trouble keeping track of things. Like, basic adult stuff. 

I just keep forgetting to pay my bills, or... I'll forget to return emails for job interviews. Missing appointments, not following through on normal errands... things like that. It's... well, it's starting to cost me some actual opportunities now. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
How much distress or anxiety are these forgetfulness issues causing you?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... it's frustrating. But I don't really know if I'd call it anxiety, or... I don't know. It's just annoying when it happens.
Do you often find yourself having trouble focusing or paying attention to details?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... like, when I was still doing biotech data work, I would think a script or a spreadsheet was completely ready. But then... later I'd realize I mislabeled a sample ID, or... skipped a note in the protocol. 

I'd submit documentation with really obvious typos that I somehow just didn't see at all. So... yeah. I guess I do have trouble with that.
Do you feel sad or down when these forgetfulness issues happen?
Um... no, not really sad. Just... I don't know. It is what it is, I guess.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble sitting still?

Yeah, I guess. Um... it's just hard to stay in one place for long. Like, if I have to sit through an interview, or a meeting... or even just watch a movie. 

I just... I get this feeling inside. Like a pressure, I guess. I just need to get up, or shift around, or... do something with my hands. If I don't, I just feel like I'm going to crawl out of my skin. So... yeah. I do get restless.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Um... I don't know. I guess I don't really know what you mean by that. Like... I just do things, I suppose. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you ever done something without thinking it through that got you into trouble?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... not that I can think of right now. Just... I don't know, nothing major, I guess.
Did you have trouble with focus, restlessness, or forgetfulness when you were a kid, like before you were 12 years old?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... even back in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I was bright, but... I was always losing my worksheets. Or I'd just rush through the directions without reading them. 

And... I guess I talked out of turn a lot. Plus my desk was always a disaster. It was so messy I could never find my assignments when it was time to turn them in. So... yeah, it's been going on for a while.
Did you have trouble sitting still or playing quietly when you were a kid?
Um... I don't really remember. I guess I just... played like normal? I'm not really sure.
Have you experienced these issues with focus, restlessness, and forgetfulness pretty consistently throughout your life, or have they gotten worse over time?

Um... I think it's gotten worse. Like... it's been seriously affecting me for... I don't know, about a year and two months now. It started getting really bad around the time things kind of... fell apart at my biotech job. And... it just kept going after I was fired. So... yeah.
Do you think your restlessness and trouble sitting still are as big of a problem for you as your trouble with focusing and remembering things?

Um... yeah, I guess they're both pretty bad. Like... if I have to sit through an interview, or a meeting... or even just watching a movie... I get this weird pressure inside. It just feels like... I have to get up, or move around, or do something with my hands. If I don't, it feels like I'm going to crawl out of my skin. So... yeah.
Have you experienced these issues with focus, restlessness, and forgetfulness in multiple areas of your life, such as at work, at home, and in social situations?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's kind of everywhere. Like... at home, and with other stuff. Since I lost my job, I've... I've missed follow-ups for interviews, which is... not great. And I had to step back from this volunteer project I actually cared about. So now I'm just... unemployed. It just feels like I can't really... manage the basic steps to move my life forward right now.
Do you think your trouble with focusing and remembering things is more of a problem for you than your restlessness and trouble sitting still?

Um... I'm not really sure. I mean... I think they're both just equally bad. Like I said, they both just kind of... get in the way of everything. So... I don't really know if one is worse than the other. They just both make things hard.
Have you had these issues with focus, restlessness, and forgetfulness for more than 6 months?

Um... yeah. It's been going on for a while. I guess... maybe about a year and two months? It really started getting bad around the time things started falling apart at my old biotech job. And... it just never really stopped, even after I got fired. So, yeah... definitely more than six months.
Have you experienced these issues with focus, restlessness, and forgetfulness at home, in social situations, and when you're alone?

Um... yeah. I guess so. I mean, I kind of already said it happens at home. And... yeah, when I'm alone, too. It's just... always there, I guess. I don't really go out much for social things right now, so... I don't know about that. But yeah, it's just... a problem.
Did you have any of these issues, like trouble focusing or sitting still, when you were very young, like before you started elementary school?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I remember in elementary school, my teachers would always write notes about me. They said I was... bright, I guess, but... I always lost my worksheets. And I'd just rush through the directions without reading them. I... talked out of turn a lot, too. My desk was just... a disaster. I could never find my assignments in there. So... yeah, I guess it's been a problem for a long time.
Do you think you had any of these issues, like trouble focusing or sitting still, before you were 7 years old?
Um... I don't really know. Seven is... pretty young. I don't remember much from back then. Just what I already said about elementary school, I guess. I'm not sure about before that.
Have you had these issues with focus, restlessness, and forgetfulness for most of your life, or did they start more recently?

Um... well, the way it is right now... it's been really bad for about a year and two months. I guess it got a lot worse around the time things started falling apart at my biotech job... and it just kind of stayed this bad after they fired me.
Did you have any of these issues before you were 12 years old, or did they start when you were older?

Um... yeah, I guess I kind of mentioned it earlier. Like I said, in elementary school... my teachers were always writing notes home. They'd say I was bright, but... I was always losing my worksheets. And I wouldn't read the directions, I'd just rush through everything. I talked out of turn a lot. My desk was always a mess, so I couldn't find anything in it. So... yeah, I guess it's been going on since before I was 12.
Did you have any of these issues before you were 5 years old?
Um... five? I really couldn't tell you. That's... I just don't have memories from that far back. I don't know.
